recall_at_5.definition: Macro-average, over test questions, of the fraction of gold passage ids present in the first 5 ranked ids.

mrr.definition: Macro-average of 1/rank of the first gold passage. Rank starts at 1. A list with no gold passage scores 0. The full returned ranking is used.

multi_hop_answer_accuracy.definition: Fraction of test questions with hop_count >= 2 whose normalized answer contains every pre-registered answer key. Single-passage questions are excluded.

citation_correctness.definition: Fraction of test questions whose cited passage-id set equals the gold passage-id set. An extra id and a missing id are both incorrect.

p95_latency_ms.definition: Nearest-rank 95th percentile of per-query end-to-end latency in milliseconds. This is not the mean, not file size, and not tokens per second.
